issue.title: Done monitor with stale followup_pending owns its bead forever
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `crates/sase_core/src/stranded_work/classify.rs` (`owner_kind()` monitor/gate branch) in the linked `sase-core` repo

A monitor member that is already `done` but still reports `followup_pending = true`
(a stale `next_action` with `followup_outcome` absent) owns its bead through
`owner_kind()`'s monitor/gate branch forever, so the bead can never become stranded.
This is the second "dead member owns forever" shape surfaced by the
`202611/stranded_adopted_staged_handoff.md` survey (the first shape — delivered staged
handoffs owning forever — is fixed on this turn).

Examples: `sase-1ih.2` (`--mon-0` done, `turn_state=running`), `sase-kp`
(`sase-kp.land--mon` done, `turn_state=failed`), `sase-ru.6` and `sase-s5`
(`turn_state=stopped`).

Repro: build a `StrandedWorkMemberFactsWire` with `turn_kind: "monitor"`,
`lifecycle: "done"`, `followup_pending: true`, no `followup_outcome`, cold
timestamps, and reduce — verdict is `owned/monitor` instead of `stranded`.
Or on live data: `collect_stranded_work_input` plus `reduce_stranded_work` for any of
the example beads above.

Impact: finished monitor turns hold their beads open indefinitely; ACE never shows
STRANDED, waiters on those beads stay parked, and the stale `next_action` is never
investigated. Needs its own root-cause check of why the follow-up never launched
before changing the ownership rule.
